lines.head: Converted leads left tasks open
lines.sub: Follow-up tasks stayed in everyone's open task lists.
lines.text: E4-4. When a lead was converted, its follow-up tasks stayed open, cluttering task lists and overdue reports.
lines.say: E four four. When a lead was converted, its follow-up tasks stayed open, cluttering task lists and overdue reports.

lines.head: Conversion now closes them
lines.sub: All of the lead's open tasks are marked completed.
lines.text: Now, converting a lead automatically marks all of its open tasks as completed.
lines.say: Now, converting a lead automatically marks all of its open tasks as completed.

lines.head: Tasks show as completed
lines.sub: On the new contact, the lead's tasks appear as done.
lines.text: Here, after conversion, the lead's follow-up tasks appear on the contact as completed.
lines.say: Here, after conversion, the lead's follow-up tasks appear on the contact as completed.

lines.head: Other tasks stay untouched
lines.sub: If the lead joins an existing contact, that contact's own tasks stay open.
lines.text: And if the lead joins an existing contact, that contact's own open tasks are left as they are.
lines.say: And if the lead joins an existing contact, that contact's own open tasks are left as they are.
